- [RLOW.1.3] **The terminal ordinal is the rule's source position.**
  The compiler emits terminals in canonical source order
  ([RLOW.14.3]) and the loader assigns each its zero-based
  index; the agenda reads that index as the first ordering
  key ([LDET.5.4]).
  Nothing is carried on the `TerminalNode` atom for ordering — the
  order IS the emission order, so there is no value to keep in
  step with it.
